
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Takes elements from one of two one-dimensional double-precision complex
    floating-point ndarrays depending on a condition.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing the following ndarrays:

        - a one-dimensional condition ndarray.
        - first one-dimensional input ndarray.
        - second one-dimensional input ndarray.
        - a one-dimensional output ndarray.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Output ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var c = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/bool}}( [ true, false ] );
    > var x = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/complex128}}( [ 1.0, -1.0, 2.0, -2.0 ] );
    > var y = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/complex128}}( [ 3.0, -3.0, 4.0, -4.0 ] );
    > var out = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/complex128}}( 2 );
    > {{alias}}( [ c, x, y, out ] )
    <ndarray>[ <Complex128>[ 1.0, -1.0 ], <Complex128>[ 4.0, -4.0 ] ]

    See Also
    --------
